integrity: All-length deductions are algebraic. Standalone finite comparisons are corroborative. No independent or external certification is claimed; relevant primary sources were compared and incomplete priority coverage is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: All inverse fibers are restricted to four-one binary palindromes at a fixed length; nonpalindromic competitors are not excluded. The original length-14 colliding pair was known. The asymptotic error is not a small-length approximation.
title: Exact three-deck fibers and a two-fifteenths ambiguity law for four-one binary palindromes
